about: WE Sign icon set: Phosphor Icons, Regular weight (@phosphor-icons/core, MIT). Keys are the Tabler names the code uses (Vue: IconTextSize is text-size; Rails: icons/_text_size.html.erb is text-size); values are Phosphor names. lib/icons/generate.mjs writes app/javascript/icons/index.js and the partials in app/views/icons from this file. 'keep' lists what is drawn as it is (brand marks, flags, an emoji, one partial with a number overlay); 'notes' says why a choice is only close.

keep.waving-hand: a colour emoji on the setup and invitation pages, not a line icon
keep.user-number: draws a number over the user glyph from a 'number' local; no view renders it

notes.2fa: Phosphor has no '2FA' lettering; password (asterisks with a cursor) is the closest.
notes.api: Phosphor has no 'API' lettering; brackets-curly is the closest.
notes.align-box-center-top: text placed at the top of its box; the align-*-simple glyphs are the nearest.
notes.align-box-left-top: a box with text lines; article is the nearest.
notes.checks: the Multiple field: list-checks, as chosen in the editor-panel preview.
notes.circle-check-filled: was a filled glyph; drawn in the Regular weight like the rest.
notes.discount-check-filled: was a filled glyph; drawn in the Regular weight like the rest.
notes.clock-cancel: no clock with a cross; clock-countdown (expired).
notes.clock-edit: no clock with a pencil; clock-user (partially completed by its signers).
notes.clock-exclamation: no clock with an exclamation mark; alarm.
notes.code-circle: no code sign in a circle; code.
notes.code-plus: no code sign with a plus; brackets-angle.
notes.columns-3: the Cells field: columns, as chosen in the editor-panel preview.
notes.email-check: no envelope with a tick; envelope-simple-open (e-mail confirmed).
notes.file-check: no file with a tick; file-text (the document was opened).
notes.file-unknown: no file with a question mark; file-dashed (not opened yet).
notes.file-symlink: no file with a link arrow; file-arrow-up.
notes.folder-up: no folder with an up arrow; folder-open.
notes.input-check: no input box with a tick; check-square-offset.
notes.letter-case-upper: the Initials field: text-a-underline, as chosen in the editor-panel preview.
notes.lock-access: no lock in a scan frame; lock-key.
notes.mail-forward: no envelope with a forward arrow; paper-plane-right (send the e-mail again).
notes.mail-up: no envelope with an up arrow; tray-arrow-up.
notes.pencil-share: no pencil with a share arrow; pencil-simple-line.
notes.phone-check: the Phone field: no handset with a tick; phone.
notes.route-alt-left: conditions: arrows-split, a path that branches.
notes.user-scan: the KBA field: no user in a scan frame; user-focus.
notes.user-share: delegation: no user with a share arrow; user-switch.
notes.users-plus: no group with a plus; user-plus.
notes.writing-sign: the Signature field: signature, as chosen in the editor-panel preview.
notes.zoom-check: verify a signed PDF: no magnifier with a tick; seal-check.
notes.inner-shadow-top: the loading spinner, which turns: spinner-gap.
